# From lecture Slides 
```{r}
gap_slope <- gapminder |>
  filter(year %in% c(1952, 2007), 
         country %in% c("United States", "Canada", "Japan") | 
           str_detect(country, "Korea")) |>
  select(country, year, gdpPercap) |>
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarize(
    `1952` = gdpPercap[year == "1952"],
    `2007` = gdpPercap[year == "2007"]) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(change = `2007` - `1952`) |>
  slice_max(change, n = 12)

gap_slope_long <- gap_slope |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`1952`, `2007`),
               names_to = "year", values_to = "gdpPercap")
```

# Data Preparation from the Lecture Slides 
```{r}
gap_slope <- gapminder |> # Create Data Frame
  filter(
    year %in% c(1992, 1997, 2002, 2007), # Only use the years we need 
    country %in% c("United States", "Canada", "Puerto Rico",
                   "Mexico", "Nicaragua", "El Salvador") # Filter to only have the countries we need for the plot
  ) |>
  select(country, year, lifeExp) |> # Pinpoint the 3 columns needed 
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |> # Create the variable 
  group_by(country) |> # Do calculations to each country separately 
  summarize(
    `1992` = lifeExp[year == "1992"],
    `1997` = lifeExp[year == "1997"],
    `2002` = lifeExp[year == "2002"],
    `2007` = lifeExp[year == "2007"]
  ) |> # Creates the columns per country and year
  ungroup() |> # Remove the grouping
  mutate(change = `2007` - `1992`) # Adds a column to show the change in the data needed 

gap_slope_long <- gap_slope |> # Convert it to include all the data 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`1992`, `1997`, `2002`, `2007`),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "lifeExp"
  ) # Reshape the data for easier use 

```
# Graph 
```{r}
ggplot(data = gap_slope_long, 
       aes(x = year, y = lifeExp, group = country, color = country)) +  # Set up the basic plot: x = year, y = life expectancy, group by country, color by country
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Draw lines connecting the points for each country, hide legend

  geom_label(
    aes(label = round(lifeExp, 0)),  # Add numbers inside the lines (life expectancy), rounded to 0 decimals
    size = 3.5,                      # Size of the text
    fill = "grey90",                  # Background color of the label
    color = "black",                  # Text color
    label.size = 0,                   # Remove the border around the label
    vjust = 0.5                       # Vertically center the text within the label
  ) +
   geom_segment(
    data = gap_slope_long |> filter(year == "1992"),
    aes(
      x = 0.85,          # slightly left of 1992 (which is position 1)
      xend = 1,           # connect to the 1992 point
      y = lifeExp,
      yend = lifeExp
    ),
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # RIGHT connecting lines (from 2007 point to country name)
  geom_segment(
    data = gap_slope_long |> filter(year == "2007"),
    aes(
      x = 4,              # 2007 position
      xend = 4.15,        # slightly to the right
      y = lifeExp,
      yend = lifeExp
    ),
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Country labels on the left (1992)
  geom_text(
    data = gap_slope_long |> filter(year == "1992"),  # Only use 1992 data for left labels
    aes(label = country),                              # Text = country name
    hjust = 1,                                        # Align text to the right
    nudge_x = -0.15,                                  # Move text slightly to the left of the line
    size = 3,                                         # Smaller text size
    fontface = "bold",                                # Make text bold
    show.legend = FALSE                               # Do not show this in the legend
  ) +

  # Country labels on the right (2007)
  geom_text(
    data = gap_slope_long |> filter(year == "2007"),  # Only use 2007 data for right labels
    aes(label = country),                              # Text = country name
    hjust = -0.2,                                     # Align text slightly left (to keep space)
    nudge_x = 0.15,                                   # Move text slightly to the right of the line
    size = 3,                                         # Smaller text size
    fontface = "bold",                                # Make text bold
    show.legend = FALSE                               # Do not show this in the legend
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(                       # Manually set line colors for each country
    "Canada" = "dodgerblue3",
    "Puerto Rico" = "chartreuse4",
    "United States" = "yellow3",
    "Mexico" = "brown2",
    "El Salvador" = "darkorange",
    "Nicaragua" = "aquamarine3"
  )) +

  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +                 # Move the x-axis labels (years) to the top
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +                      # Allow labels to extend beyond plot edges

  labs(
    x = NULL,                                          # Remove x-axis label
    y = NULL,                                          # Remove y-axis label
    title = "Life Expectancy by Country",             # Main title
    subtitle = "Selected American countries",        # Subtitle
    caption = "source: gapminder"                     # Caption/source
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",                          # Remove legend
    plot.margin = margin(10, 120, 10, 120),           # Add extra space on left/right for labels

    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),  # Panel background
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),   # Plot background

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),                # Remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),                # Remove minor grid lines

    axis.text.y = element_blank(),                     # Remove y-axis numbers
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),                    # Remove y-axis ticks
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),                    # Remove x-axis ticks (years on top)

    axis.text.x = element_text(                        # Customize x-axis text
      face = "bold",                                   # Bold x-axis text
      size = rel(2)                                    # Make it larger relative to default
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(                         # Customize title
      hjust = 0.5,                                     # Center horizontally
      face = "bold"                                    # Bold title
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(                      # Customize subtitle
      hjust = 0.5,                                     # Center horizontally
      face = "italic"                                  # Italic subtitle
    )
  )
```
